title: Contract Chorus: ARR pipeline grid (working)
content:
Spreadsheet: Contract Chorus ARR grid (working copy)

Columns:
Account | Segment | ARR (USD) | Contract start | Contract end | Renewal window (days) | Renewal probability (%) | Confidence (H/M/L) | Health score (1-10) | Last touch date | Next step (owner + action) | Escalation required? | Playbook reference | Notes / blockers

Rows:
Acme Retail | Mid-market | 185000 | 2023-08-01 | 2026-08-01 | 90 | 78 | H | 8 | 2026-06-18 | CS Lead (Ava) — executive check-in + ROI one-pager due 2026-07-25 | No | upsell+price-discussion | Customer running heavy inference workloads, positive perf metrics; ask infra team for token-cost breakdown before exec call.
ByteWave Analytics | Growth | 95,000 | 2024-01-15 | 2026-09-30 | 120 | 42 | M | 5 | 2026-06-02 | AE (Diego) — technical due diligence with infra eng (request dedicated capacity proposal) by 2026-07-22 | Yes (SSE) | dedicated-capacity-play | Pricing sensitive; want guaranteed latency under 120ms for production queries. Need a short benchmark doc to share.
Nimbus Health | Enterprise | 1,250,000 | 2022-11-01 | 2026-11-01 | 120 | 61 | M | 7 | 2026-06-30 | CS (Priya) — schedule compliance / SOC2 + KMS discussion w/security by 2026-07-28 | Yes (security) | private-deployments-checklist | Regulatory pause: legal requesting on-prem reference; procurement timeline uncertain.
FinEdge Capital | Enterprise | 420,000 | 2025-02-10 | 2026-10-10 | 75 | 88 | H | 9 | 2026-07-05 | CS Lead (Owen) — draft renewal contract with modest price increase; propose 12-month commit with discount tiers by 2026-07-18 | No | standard-renewal-template | High engagement, finance already signaled willingness to commit.
RetailCo Direct | Mid-market | 60,500 | 2023-09-20 | 2026-09-19 | 60 | 29 | L | 4 | 2026-05-12 | AE — re-introduce low-cost hosted flow + mapping session, target 2026-07-30 | Possibly | churn-mitigation-kit | Usage decline; running competitor pilot. Short win required.
SmallApps Inc | Startup | 12,000 | 2025-07-01 | 2026-07-01 | 30 | 15 | L | 3 | 2026-06-01 | CS — offer seat-lifted free month + playbook onboarding by 2026-06-25 | No | startup-retention-play | Very price sensitive; low ARR but high churn risk.

Pipeline roll-up (manual working numbers):
Total named ARR in sheet: $2,022,500
Weighted ARR (ARR * probability):
Acme: 185,000 * 0.78 = 144,300
ByteWave: 95,000 * 0.42 = 39,900
Nimbus: 1,250,000 * 0.61 = 762,500
FinEdge: 420,000 * 0.88 = 369,600
RetailCo: 60,500 * 0.29 = 17,545
SmallApps: 12,000 * 0.15 = 1,800
Estimated renewal capture (sum weighted): $1,335,645

Open questions / actions (TO-DO list):
- Action: Assemble 1-pager benchmark for ByteWave (owner: engineering solutions) — due 2026-07-15.
- Action: Security/Legal pathfinding for Nimbus (owner: Priya) — need contact at security to get HLD for private deployment by 2026-07-22.
- Action: Draft updated terms for FinEdge showing 12-month commit + 5% discount bands (owner: Owen) — draft to Legal (ticket LEG-933) by 2026-07-16.
- Question: RetailCo pilot end date — confirm with AE; if pilot ends before 2026-07-30, prepare a targeted retention offer.
- Note: Consider running a micro-sim: 3 scenarios (conservative, base, optimistic) where probabilities are scaled by 0.75/1.0/1.2 to generate ARR capture ranges; embed column "Chorus scenario" to show variant outputs.

Working model example (quick):
- Conservative capture estimate = weighted ARR * 0.75 = $1,001,734
- Optimistic capture estimate = weighted ARR * 1.2 = $1,602,774

Meeting prep (QBR touchpoints):
- Create 10-minute briefing slides for execs focused on top-5 deals affecting ARR > $300k — attach to QBR deck.
- Template: talk track = (1) current capture estimate, (2) top blockers, (3) proposed commitments (legal/tech/discount), (4) ask for exec sponsor or SLA carveout.

Notes to self (informal):
- This sheet is intentionally compact — we'll split to per-region tabs if >50 rows.
- Keep a short audit trail of pricing offers (link to doc store) to avoid re-negotiation mismatches.

References / links to playbooks:
- dedicated-capacity-play (confluence link above)
- private-deployments-checklist (confluence)
- churn-mitigation-kit (CS playbook)

Revision history (short):
- 2026-07-12: initial import from weekly CS sync (Ava)
- 2026-07-15: probability updates after AE outreach (Diego)
- 2026-07-20: added weighted ARR summary + open actions (Ava)

End of sheet.
